title: CAMP GX600 fitted-tire and ride owner reference
publisher: XHS public post; publisher authority unverified
notes: Single GX600 owner report names fitted nominal700x40C and a subjective subdued ride feel. Trim, tire/rim, size, year and modifications are unknown. Fitted width does not prove maximum clearance or retained PES stock specification; no tire-causation finding.

reference_claims.claim: Owner describes nominal 700x40C tires on a recently purchased GX600.
reference_claims.limitations: Text-only owner report; fitted width is not measured width or manufacturer maximum. Trim, rim, model year, tire make and mud clearance are unknown. Do not replace retained PES stock 35C or close maximum-clearance gap.

reference_claims.claim: Owner says the bike feels light but does not feel lively while riding and questions whether wider tires are responsible.
reference_claims.limitations: Subjective single-owner impression. Tire causation, pressures, terrain, rider and selected PES configuration are unproven.

capture.scope: Previously validated local detail archive; raw bodies, account identifiers and original media remain private and outside Git. No child pixel review.
